Individual energies and barriers are compared to paper's Table 2 and text values with tolerances.

outputs.description: Extracted intramolecular rotational barrier heights. The checker compares the reported results to hidden reference values with a defined tolerance.

Per-conformer relative energies (ΔE) at two basis sets, Boltzmann populations at 298 K, and average enthalpies of formation from isodesmic reactions. The checker compares each value to hidden reference values within defined tolerances.
Boltzmann-weighted gas-phase enthalpy of formation ΔfH(298 K) of cumene hydroperoxide. The checker compares the single number to the hidden reference value.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are compared against hidden reference values obtained from the original paper. The agent must compute them from scratch using the described DFT workflow; no pre-computed values are provided. The load-bearing step_06 ensures that upstream process steps (geometry optimization, frequency calculations, single-point energies, reference molecule calculations) are genuinely executed because the final populations and enthalpies depend on these intermediate energies.
